newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet dips as IPE futures fall and premiums slip.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet dips as IPE futures fall and premiums slip.

text.p: European jet fuel was knocked lower on Monday reflecting easier IPE futures and narrowly weaker premiums.
But activity was very slim with most players looking at balanced books and enjoying industry functions in London.
"I haven't seen any deals done and there have been no fresh cargoes offered," said one trader.
March IPE gas oil fell $2.50 a tonne to $174.75 and premiums slipped by $1-2. Traders said barges were pegged around March IPE +$24-25 fob with cargoes around March IPE +$26 cif NWE.
